names: the stock-info price note (and its QA twin) counts a stale last close from the page's own reference date — 'PRICE STALE AT THE REFERENCE DATE: … N calendar days before the page's reference date <date>' — never from today, so the synthesis request no longer moves with the calendar (operator, 2026-11-12: 'Yes, fix it'); the assembly-time check against today is a stderr warning only, never on the page
